# A stash is worth what he gives you after he is back: rest-of-season value x the share of the season left once
# he returns. The newcomer takes a slot only when he is worth more than the weakest occupant; a player who is no
# longer IR-eligible is the first to go.
$IR_ELIG = @("IR", "PUP", "NFI", "COV", "Out")
function IRWorth($k) { $p = PX $k; if (-not $p) { return 0.0 }; $info = PInfo $k; $wo = OutWeeks $k ([string]$p.inj) $(if ($info) { [string]$info.injPart } else { "" }); if ($null -eq $wo) { $wo = 4.0 }; $left = [double]$weeksLeftNFL; if ($left -le 0) { return 0.0 }; return [math]::Round([double](N $p.rosWk) * [math]::Max(0.0, $left - [double]$wo) / $left, 1) }
function IRPlan($k, $act) {
  $me0 = PX $k; $nm = $(if ($me0) { $me0.name } else { $k })
  $occ = @(); foreach ($r in $ir) { if (-not $r) { continue }; $rp = PX $r.player; if ($rp) { $occ += @{ key = $r.player; name = $rp.name; inj = [string]$rp.inj; worth = (IRWorth $r.player) } } }
  $healthy = @($occ | Where-Object { $_.inj -notin $IR_ELIG })
  if ($healthy.Count) { return ("Move " + $healthy[0].name + " off IR (no longer IR-eligible; bench him if there is room, else drop) and put " + $nm + " on IR; " + $act) }
  $cw = IRWorth $k
  $weak = $occ | Sort-Object { $_.worth } | Select-Object -First 1
  if ($weak -and $cw -gt ($weak.worth + 0.5)) { return ("IR is full: drop " + $weak.name + " (worth " + $weak.worth + "/wk the rest of the way vs " + $cw + " for " + $nm + ") and put " + $nm + " on IR; " + $act) }
  $keep = $(if ($me0 -and (N $me0.rosWk) -ge 8) { "hold him on the bench or shop him" } else { "drop him" })
  return ("IR is full and both stashes are worth more the rest of the way (" + (($occ | ForEach-Object { $_.name + " " + $_.worth }) -join ", ") + " vs " + $cw + " for " + $nm + "): " + $keep + "; " + $act)
}
